text:
morgan: quick sync — followups from the OOM incident last night. We surfaced a repeating pattern of KV cache residency growth + slab fragmentation. Need owners and timelines for profiling, limits, GC tuning, and short-term mitigations. I'll list action items; please claim or update ETA.

ankur: I can take profiling. Will run heap snapshots + flamegraphs across canary and prod nodes, correlate with recent model rollouts. ETA: EOD Thu (2026-03-26).

sara: I'll pick up eviction tuning experiments (lower transitory TTL, bump soft limit). Can run two canaries and report perf/cost impact. ETA: Mon (2026-03-30).

luca: I'll validate allocator metrics and add per-shard residency histograms to the tracing pipeline. Also add a span to track KV put sizes. ETA: Fri (2026-03-27).

tim: I'll own GC sweep policy testing — try more aggressive fragmentation compaction on a 1% canary. Also prepare rollback plan. ETA: Tue (2026-03-31).

alyssa: I'll own rollback + incident comms. If canaries regress, we revert model variant and post updates to #incidents.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-24T05:12Z -> rollout started for kv-tuning-experiment-1 (id: cb-842).

morgan: Notes / quick references:
- Profiler command: ```./bin/heap-profiler --target=runtime --duration=60s --out=/tmp/snap.hprof```
- Temp mitigation: `kv.spec.soft_limit_ratio = 0.6` and `evict_ttl_ms = 300000` (5m) for transitory keys.
- Observed pattern: slow steady increase in per-shard resident bytes starting ~30m after large batch reroute (see traces).

ankur: Will attach two flamegraph links once done. Also will diff heap snapshots pre/post canary.

sara: Quick ask — anyone seen similar growth correlated with large prompt caching? If yes, we should add a telemetry flag for prompt-cache evictions.

luca: Yes, saw a correlation last quarter. I'm adding an opt-in telemetry label `cache.seed_type` so we can filter.

morgan: Ownership summary (putting here so ops can track):
- Profiling & heap diffs: ankur (EOD Thu)
- Eviction experiments: sara (Mon)
- Allocator/tracing hist: luca (Fri)
- GC policy testing: tim (Tue)
- Rollback & comms: alyssa (on-call)

morgan: Followups: everyone please drop a one-line progress update in this thread when your ETAs shift or tests complete. We'll reconvene Wed sync to decide permanent mitigations if experiments show positive signal. :thumbsup:

ankur: claimed and noted. will post artifacts as links.

sara: claimed. starting canary config now.

luca: instrumentation PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4821 (adding histograms).

tim: scheduling GC canary for Fri AM but can move earlier if needed.

morgan: thanks — adding these to the postmortem action tracker. If anyone needs help pairing, ping me or @alyssa.

alyssa: ack. I updated the incident board with owners + ETA: https://boards.redwood/oom-postmortem-2026-03 (private).

morgan: closing loop for now. will mark this thread as the canonical thread for these followups.

deploy-bot: Canary cb-842 rolled back after regression detected in 2/50 canaries at 2026-03-24T06:03Z.

ankur: saw rollback — will prioritize heap diffs from the failed canary machine first.

sara: paused new eviction canaries until profiler artifacts are in.

morgan: updated ETAs: ankur keeps EOD Thu; rest hold until profiler gives signal. thanks all.
